records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2023 increased by $1.1 billion, or 26%, and $2.2 billion, or 26%, compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription and services-based revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2023 increased by $366.6 million, or 33%, and $773.3 million, or 38% compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit was $1.9 billion, up 27% year over year, driven primarily by our Cash App and Square ecosystems.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We continued to exercise expense discipline and are focused on driving long-term growth.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the second quarter of 2023, operating loss was $132.1 million and Adjusted Operating Income was $25.5 million.
